item.title: Commentary: Tsinghua Unigroup distances itself from failed US$15 billion Dongguan chip-cloud project
item.summary: Tsinghua Unigroup's former "chip-to-cloud" expansion strategy unraveled after a debt crisis in 2020 and subsequent bankruptcy restructuring. Several projects originating in the group's earlier era have since entered disposal proceedings, and one of the former group's largest planned investments has now reached a formal end.
